purpose: Prepare the approved temporal-memory benchmark inputs: one dev conversation environment, full history, temporal category-2 dev questions plus fixed non-temporal controls, two fresh capture manifests differing only in settings.evidenceTimestamps.

dev_split.source: existing LoCoMo DEV split (300 questions, 10 environments, seed 20261007)
dev_split.note: Dev question rows were regenerated with the current repo-continuation converter (optimus-locomo-conversion/2.0.0) into c04-temporal-inputs/common/locomo; the selected qid set was verified identical to the existing dev split qids. The converter's full planning manifest under common/locomo/full/ contains gold and was never read for selection.

selection_blindness.rule: Env and question selection use only stable SHA-256 hashes of ids and dev-split metadata (category counts). No scores, answers, gold, evidence, or run outcomes were read or used at any selection step.

env_selection.rule: Order the 10 dev environment ids by SHA256('<env_seed>:<env_id>') ascending, ties by env_id; take rank 1.

temporal.rule: From the chosen env's dev questions with category=='2' (temporal), order by SHA256('<q_seed>:<qid>') ascending, ties by qid; take the first <=8.

controls.rule: From the chosen env's remaining dev questions (category!='2'), order by SHA256('<control_seed>:<qid>') ascending, ties by qid; take the first <=2.

arms.only_difference: settings.evidenceTimestamps (false vs true). Env (verbatim full history, roles, event.ts), question declarations, prompts (answerInstruction/importInstructions), all other settings, and model dgx-glm53/glm-5.3 are byte-identical between arms. run_id, variant and output_dir differ as run identity only.

capture.role_policy: driver SourceAuthorityV1: locomo user/assistant events both imported as user evidence (identical both arms)
capture.timestamp_source: converter event.ts only; no synthetic clock; naive ISO preserved as UTC
capture.stores: fresh independent capture stores per arm; no reuse of existing stores/jobs

cost_bounds.estimator: Python replication of driver write_session_files + jobs.rs import chunk packing; validated exactly against the historical conv-41 run (33 chunks at 15000, legacy undated) in campaign runs/locomo/s2
cost_bounds.blocker: conv-41 needs >=32 extraction chunks/arm (one import job per session, >=1 chunk per job) and 64/68 at the baseline 8000-char chunk budget. The <=20 gate cannot be met by conv-41 at any chunk budget. No replacement env was chosen; see README for parent options.
